# The Straits Times

> > Singapore's leading news organization delivering breaking news, in-depth analysis, and multimedia coverage across Singapore, Asia, and global affairs with emphasis on geopolitics, business, and regional developments.

The Straits Times is Singapore's flagship English-language newspaper providing comprehensive news coverage across multiple verticals including politics, business, lifestyle, and sports. The publication emphasizes breaking news, strategic analysis on geopolitics involving key regional players like China, Japan, and the US, and multimedia journalism through videos and podcasts.

## Key Topics

- Iran-US Conflict

- Singapore Politics

## News Hubs

- [Homepage](https://www.straitstimes.com): Homepage featuring breaking news, Singapore, Asia and world news coverage
- [Breaking News](https://www.straitstimes.com/breaking-news): Breaking news aggregation featuring latest Singapore, Asia and regional updates
- [Singapore News](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore): Singapore news hub covering local breaking news, crime, education and housing
- [Asia News](https://www.straitstimes.com/asia): Asia news section covering Southeast Asia, East Asia and regional headlines
- [World News](https://www.straitstimes.com/world): World news covering United States, Europe, Middle East and international stories

## Business & Markets

- [Business News](https://www.straitstimes.com/business): Business news covering markets, economy, finance and corporate developments
- [Investors Face Cloudier Fed Rate View as Iran War Grips Markets](https://www.straitstimes.com/business/economy/investors-face-cloudier-fed-rate-view-as-iran-war-grips-markets): Federal Reserve rate outlook clouded by Iran conflict and rising oil prices

- [US Weighs Military Reinforcements as Iran War Enters Possible New Phase](https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/us-weighs-military-reinforcements-as-iran-war-enters-possible-new-phase): US military deployment considerations as Iran conflict potentially escalates
- [Live: Trump Rules Out Further Attacks by Israel on Iran's Gas Field Unless Tehran Retaliates](https://www.straitstimes.com/world/live-us-israel-strike-iran-as-trump-urges-uprising): Live coverage of Middle East conflict with Trump, Israel and Iran tensions
